preregistration.promotion_rule: large is promoted only if, in BOTH rounds, its validation denoising loss and validation mean W1 beat base with blocked 95 percent intervals entirely below zero, and its parameter count stays within 3.0x of base and its sampling cost within 2.5x of base

equal_compute.comparison: equal training compute: same epochs, batch, learning rate, optimizer, and seeds

convergence_normalized.comparison: convergence-normalized: each arm trained for its median epochs-to-convergence from round 1 (first epoch within 5 percent of its final equal-compute train loss)

reasons: val_w1 CI (0.024165125631119267, 0.034189393699215996) does not exclude zero: no measured validation-W1 gain
